sudden_power_drop.transformation: P_new = P * (1 - reduction_fraction); V_new = V * (1 - reduction_fraction)

sustained_power_reduction.transformation: P_new = P * (1 - reduction_fraction); V_new = V * (1 - reduction_fraction)

temporary_near_zero_power.transformation: P_new = P * retained_fraction; V_new = V * retained_fraction

sudden_power_spike.transformation: P_new = P * (1 + increase_fraction); V_new = V * (1 + increase_fraction)

gradual_power_degradation.transformation: factor_j = 1 - final_reduction_fraction * j / n; P_new_j = P_j * factor_j; V_new_j = V_j * factor_j; j = 1..n

radiation_power_inconsistency.transformation: S_new = S * (1 + radiation_increase_fraction); power, voltage, and current unchanged

sensor_excursion.transformation: x_new = x + direction * magnitude; reject humidity candidate outside [0, 100]

sampling_policy: severity then uniform feasible duration then uniform sorted eligible start; reserve later minimum durations
interpretation: Controlled prototype cases, not verified real photovoltaic fault signatures.
